project_title: Editor Collage da Galleria - Stampa Foto Alta Qualità
emotional_tone: Studio fotografico professionale, raffinato, elegante, moderno ed armonioso

typography.label: text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-400
typography.instructions: Use font Google Fonts import in index.html for Outfit & JetBrains Mono.

spacing_and_layout.editor_structure: Full-height app layout (h-screen overflow-hidden). Header (top 56px), Left Sidebar for Uploads & Asset Gallery (320px), Center Interactive Canvas (flex-1), Right Sidebar for Format, Frame, Passe-Partout & Layout Controls (340px). Bottom Toolbar for Zoom/Fit/3D Wall View.
spacing_and_layout.border_padding: Internal padding inside borders minimum p-4 or p-6 to avoid text collisions.
spacing_and_layout.responsive_strategy: On small screens (mobile/tablet), collapse sidebars into slide-over sheets or drawer tabs, preserving canvas center focus.

key_features.name: Selettore Formato e Orientamento (Format & Orientation Picker)
key_features.description: Scelta formati di stampa reali: 50x70 cm, 40x110 cm, 30x40 cm, 70x50 cm, 50x50 cm. Orientamento Verticale, Orizzontale, Quadrato. Anteprima dimensioni reali in mm/cm e risoluzione necessaria in pixel.

key_features.name: Personalizzazione Cornice e Passe-partout (Frame & Mat Configurator)
key_features.description: Cornici in legno naturale, nero, bianco, alluminio. Passe-partout regolabile (spessore, margini, colore bianco/crema/nero), simulazione vetro acrilico anti-riflesso e profondità 3D.

key_features.name: Gestione Layout Griglia (Layout Grid Templates)
key_features.description: Template flessibili per 2, 3, 4, 6, 9, 12, 24, 52 foto. Regolazione dinamica di spaziatura (gutter/gap), raggio angoli, proporzioni celle e simmetria.

key_features.name: Caricamento e Gestione Foto (Photo Drag & Drop Upload)
key_features.description: Caricamento file ad alta risoluzione (JPG, PNG, WEBP), libreria foto di esempio ad alta definizione per prova immediata, indicatore qualità DPI per ogni foto caricata.

key_features.name: Editor Foto Canvas Interattivo (Interactive Cell Editor)
key_features.description: Trascina e rilascia foto nelle celle, pan/zoom foto nella cella, scambia foto tra celle (swap), filtri colore (B&W, Seppia, Nitido, Caldo, Freddo), rotazione e ritaglio.

key_features.name: Modalità Simulazione Parete 3D (Living Room Wall Mockup)
key_features.description: Visualizzazione realistica del collage incorniciato appeso in un soggiorno/galleria per valutare l'impatto d'arredo prima della stampa.

key_features.name: Esportazione e Salvataggio Progetto (Print-Ready Export 300 DPI & Save/Load)
key_features.description: Download in formato PDF/JPG pronto per tipografia (300 DPI simulati), salvataggio progetto locale/server, ripristino progetti e scheda specifiche per centro stampa.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow Italian language for all UI elements, labels, buttons, tooltips, toasts, modals, and export options.
Build a rich interactive canvas where users can click any cell to assign/drag a photo, adjust zoom/pan, apply filters (B&W, Sepia, Vivid, Warm, Cool), or swap photos.
Include a live DPI Calculator badge in the canvas showing resolution health (e.g. '300 DPI - Eccellente per stampa 50x70cm').
Provide interactive Frame Configurator (Wood depth, Matte border width slider, Mat background color picker).
Provide a realistic 'Vista Parete Soggiorno' modal/toggle that places the custom framed collage in a photo-realistic living room wall context.
Export options should generate print-ready PNG/JPG canvas downloads and a detailed Print Specification Summary PDF/Sheet with color space CMYK/RGB recommendations and resolution specs.
Ensure Sonner toast notifications alert user upon uploading, saving project, auto-arranging, or exporting.
All interactive elements MUST have explicit data-testid attributes.

do_not: Do NOT use transparent dropdown backgrounds or plain unstyled native inputs.
Do NOT use generic centered hero text without visual hierarchy.
Do NOT use transition: all. Use explicit transitions on background, border, opacity, color.
do: Use explicit hover state text colors (e.g. hover:bg-amber-500 hover:text-black).
Include realistic default uploaded photos so the user sees a stunning high-resolution gallery frame collage immediately on launch.
Keep crisp high-contrast UI borders with slate/zinc dark tones for a professional dark studio workspace.
